label: Core update and spam
lines: The November Core Update is still rolling out, and Google added FAQs to its back button hijacking spam policy.
Glenn Gabe sees big surges and drops since about Nov. 13, and SERP trackers lost up to 98% of their data on Nov. 18 (Derek Perkins).
Judge drops in GSC, not Nov. 18 rank data, and audit scaled AI pages and thin location pages.

label: AIOs on Gemini 4 Hydrogen
lines: Google moved Search to Gemini 4 Hydrogen on Nov. 17, with better intent understanding, smarter query fan-out and more links.
David Konitzny tracked 88M+ AIOs, and only 51.8% put the first inline link in the first third on Nov. 20, down from 76.8% on Sept. 21.
Recheck AIO citations for priority keywords, and answer the follow-up questions that fan-out asks.

label: AI visibility tracking
lines: New studies show that AI citations change fast and differ by platform.
Ahrefs found that about 3 in 4 lost citations were temporary, and DataForSEO shows that AIOs cite YouTube most and ChatGPT cites Wikipedia most.
Report citation trends over two or three weeks, not single checks, and test YouTube for clients that invest in AI search.

label: Content that earns visibility
lines: Google and SEO experts say generic content loses, while real expertise and original data win.
Think with Google told CMOs to stop generic 'Top 10' posts, and Cyrus Shepard's Ahrefs study of 535 sites found that blog posts did badly at earning links.
Check each planned post for first-hand knowledge, original data and a named expert before we write it.

label: Local SEO and AI
lines: Ask Maps now calls local businesses for users, and Google is bringing it to Europe.
Whitespark found the business website in 86% of Maps Web Results across 21,000+ businesses.
Check each client's GBP call setting, keep websites and citations complete, and get reviews beyond Google.

label: WordPress and site health
lines: WordPress 7.1.5 fixes 18 flaws, and WordPress 7.2 ships Dec. 8 with a new /random/ URL that is on by default.
Rank Math had 16 flaws in 2026, and a hacked Optimizely script reached 178 organizations (Search Engine Journal).
Update core and Rank Math now, and decide before Dec. 8 which client sites need code to turn off /random/.

label: AI Mode inside Search
lines: Google keeps adding to AI Mode: a sidebar for past chats, Dive Deeper links, Connected Apps and hotel booking.
Google also tests removing AI Mode from the top navigation, and desktop queries of 5+ words grew from 29.3% to 34.8% in a year (DataForSEO).
Do not opt client sites out of AI features, since organic clicks dropped in Cyrus Shepard's opt-out test.

label: AI traffic and attribution
lines: Analytics undercount AI visits, and ChatGPT Business Hub gives very little data so far.
Nearly 7 in 10 US Google searches ended without a click from January to April, and Barry Schwartz had zero Business Hub data after a week.
Add a 'How did you hear about us?' field to client forms, and do not use Business Hub numbers as benchmarks yet.

label: Google Search Profiles
lines: Google Search Profiles are now live worldwide.
Barry Schwartz confirmed the rollout, and Lily Ray reports that Google flagged her Substack link with no way to dispute it.
Claim and complete Search Profiles for client authors, and check which links Google flags.

label: AI ads and paid search
lines: Ads, shopping results and coupon codes now show inside AI answers.
Writesonic found ads in 18.94% of ChatGPT answers on Nov. 16, and Microsoft confirmed Bing ads in AIOs in all markets except China.
Audit AI Max search terms, test the new PMax channel caps, and check client coupon and product prompts.

label: AI agents and crawlers
lines: Google and Microsoft now build crawlers, tools and test webs for AI agents.
Google documented Google-Agent and 12 more crawlers and fetchers, and Nectiv found that 22% of 300 tech sites serve markdown to agents.
Check robots.txt rules and logs for the new agents and fetchers, and see which clients should apply for Connected Apps.

label: Search Console and Google tags
lines: The Search Analytics API now labels queries as branded or non-branded, and Google Tags are now Tag Manager containers.
Kevin Indig sees bot traffic in GSC and GA4 for many clients, and Lily Ray got a warning after one Request Indexing click.
Pull non-branded clicks from the API, and flag bot spikes before you report growth.

label: SEO vs GEO debate
lines: Big brands say SEO is dead, but SEO experts show that AI search still runs on SEO basics.
Salesforce's CEO posted 'Goodbye SEO', while OpenAI hires a B2B SEO and AEO lead at $239k to $265k.
Keep client budgets on SEO fundamentals, and skip AI schema and llms.txt add-ons that Neil Patel says Google Search ignores.

label: AI model and app launches
lines: Google released Gemini 4 Neon, after new models from OpenAI and Microsoft.
Gemini 4 Neon use on Perplexity grew 10.6% a day (Aravind Srinivas), and OpenAI says GPT-6.2 Astra writes shorter answers by default.
Retest saved prompts on the new models, since answers and sources change.
